drafted_from: tool:google-account-create_draft's own row in tools/read-and-write-gmail/tool-rows.json (invoke method, url, body_template, input and output schema); Gmail response values worked out from that row for the synthetic input
start_here: Say to your AI: "Save a draft email from me to alex@example.com saying the bakery order is ready at 3 PM. Use my Google account connection service_connection:google-account:sam-bakery." It runs tool:google-account-create_draft as that account and hands back the Gmail answer.
no_lists_because: It keeps no list: it calls Gmail for one Google account the connection names and answers what Gmail returns.
instructions: 1. Connect a Google account in your Workshop connections and note its handle, like service_connection:google-account:sam-bakery.

2. Say to your AI: "Save a draft email from me to alex@example.com saying the bakery order is ready at 3 PM." and let it call run_resource_operation at @workshop-tools with method tools:run, tool tool:google-account-create_draft, and the input {"connection":{"connection_id":"service_connection:google-account:sam-bakery"},"raw":"RnJvbTogc2FtQGV4YW1wbGUuY29tDQpUbzogYWxleEBleGFtcGxlLmNvbQ0KU3ViamVjdDogT3JkZXIgcGlja3VwDQoNCllvdXIgYmFrZXJ5IG9yZGVyIGlzIHJlYWR5IGF0IDMgUE0u","thread_id":"18c1a2b3d4e5f601"}.
3. Read what comes back: the request goes as POST  the Gmail me-mailbox base (gmail.googleapis.com, v1)/drafts with the body {"message":{"raw":"<that raw>","threadId":"18c1a2b3d4e5f601"}}.
4. Leave thread_id out for a new conversation. The draft is saved, not sent; send it with tool:google-account-send_draft.

worked_examples.title: Save a Gmail draft on a sample input
worked_examples.ask: Save a draft email from me to alex@example.com saying the bakery order is ready at 3 PM.
worked_examples.given: read from tools/read-and-write-gmail/tool-rows.json (its invoke url, method and body_template) and checked against tools/read-and-write-gmail/test/rows.test.mjs. raw is the base64url of "From: sam@example.com / To: alex@example.com / Subject: Order pickup / blank line / Your bakery order is ready at 3 PM." and thread_id 18c1a2b3d4e5f601 makes it a reply draft. The call it makes: POST the Gmail me-mailbox base (gmail.googleapis.com, v1)/drafts with the body {"message":{"raw":"<that raw>","threadId":"18c1a2b3d4e5f601"}}.
